questions.question: In a certain code language, 'FROZEN' is coded as '504' and 'TONSILS' is coded as '756'. How will 'MARINE' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00825e41553d5ba26d237043256f810f869b9838b55d9f2ea0e156c21de9b1df.png] 

'FROZEN' is coded as '504' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd8093a5187234c61cefd0cc4a2d3c47f374a8b41c3b2b45788edd52f52f21c7.png] 

**Sum of alphabet positional values × Number of letters in the given word**

 
• 6 + 18 + 15 + 26 + 5 + 14 = 84

Number of letter in word FROZEN = 6

 
• 84 × 6 = 504

And 

'TONSILS' is coded as '756'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cedabd12b264e53b690ce52fb60b7be1ea20cca1d0ba6740cf0f82a27ddf937.png] 

Sum of alphabet positional values × Number of letters in the given word

 
• 20 + 15 + 14 + 19 + 9 + 12 + 19 = 108

Number of letter in word TONSILS = 7

 
• 108 × 7 = 756

Similarly,

'MARINE' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e81c8dbea44b99e9cf7c65feea476066be58ea7699570c12a5f213bb235af1.png] 

Sum of alphabet positional values × Number of letters in the given word

 
• **13 + 1 + 18 + 9 + 14 + 5 = 60**

**Number of letter in word MARINE = 6**

 
• **60 × 6 = 360**

Hence, the correct answer is **"360".**

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers in the set share the same relationship as that shared by the numbers of the given set.

(14, 18, 42)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**Third number = (First number × Second number) ÷ 6**

 
• (14, 18, 42) → (14 × 18) ÷ 6 = 252 ÷ 6 = 42

Similarly,

 
• (16, 21, 56) → (16 × 21) ÷ 6 = 336 ÷ 6 = 56

Hence, the correct answer is **"(16, 21, 56)".**

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs to balance the following equation.

40 * 15 * 3 * 72 * 9 = 77
questions.solution:
By using **BODMAS RULE **:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29cd466ebe6ac0e990c26fcd20077484f20775d97bda530273827995a99c5483.png] 

Option 1) : +, ÷, −, ×, =

Given : 40 * 15 * 3 * 72 * 9 = 77

By replacing the symbols in given equation the equation followed is : 40 + 15 ÷ 3 - 72 × 9 = 77 

⇒ 40 + 15 ÷ 3 - 72 × 9 = 77

⇒ 40 + 5 - 72 × 9 = 77 

⇒ 40 + 5 - 648 = 77 

⇒ 45 - 648 = 77 

⇒ - 603 ≠ 77 

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : ×, ÷, +, −, =

Given : 40 * 15 * 3 * 72 * 9 = 77

By replacing the symbols in given equation the equation followed is : 40 × 15 ÷ 3 + 72 - 9 = 77 

⇒ 40 × 15 ÷ 3 + 72 - 9 = 77 

⇒ 40 × 5 + 72 - 9 = 77

⇒ 200 + 72 - 9 = 77 

⇒ 272 - 9 = 77 

⇒ 263 ≠ 77 

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : +, ×, ÷, −, =

Given : 40 * 15 * 3 * 72 * 9 = 77

By replacing the symbols in given equation the equation followed is : 40 + 15 × 3 ÷ 72 - 9 = 77 

⇒ 40 + 15 × 3 ÷ 72 - 9 = 77

⇒ 40 + 15 × 0.041 - 9 = 77

⇒ 40 + 0.625 - 9 = 77

⇒ 40.625 - 9 = 77

⇒ 31.625 ≠ 77

LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 4) : +, ×, −, ÷, =**

**Given : 40 * 15 * 3 * 72 * 9 = 77**

**By replacing the symbols in given equation the equation followed is : 40 + 15 × 3 - 72 ÷ 9 = 77**

**⇒ 40 + 15 × 3 - 72 ÷ 9 = 77 **

**⇒ 40 + 15 × 3 - 8 = 77 **

**⇒ 40 + 45 - 8 = 77 **

**⇒ 85 - 8 = 77 **

**⇒ 77 = 77**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"+, ×, −, ÷, =".**

questions.solution:

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

c k _ g k c _ t _ k _ k t g _ c k _ g k

options.text: t, k, g, c, c, t
t, k, c, g, k, t
t, k, g, c, k, t
t, g, k, c, k, t

questions.solution:
Given :- c k _ g k c _ t _ k _ k t g _ c k _ g k

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) t, k, g, c, c, t → c k **t** g k / c **k** t **g** k / **c **k t g **c** / c k **t** g k

2) t, k, c, g, k, t → c k **t** g k / c **k** t **c **k / **g** k t g **k /** c k **t** g k

3) t, k, g, c, k, t → c k **t** g k / c **k** t **g** k / **c** k t g **k** / c k **t** g k

4) t, g, k, c, k, t → c k **t** g k / c **g** t **k** k / **c** k t g **k** / c k **t** g k

Option (3) gives a pattern of **cktgk** - cktgk - cktgk - **cktgk**

 
• Here the option (3) represents the pattern as : c k t g k / c k t g k / c k t g k / c k t g k

Hence, the correct answer is **"t, k, g, c, k, t".**

questions.question: In a class of 68 students, 34 students participated only in Debate and 8 students participated in both Quiz and Debate. If every student of the class has participated in at least one of these two competitions, how many students participated in Quiz?
questions.solution:
Given Total number of students = 68

Number of students participated only in Debate = 34

Number of students participated in both Quiz and Debate = 8

**If every student of the class has participated in at least one of these two competitions**

Number of students participated only in Quiz = Total number of students - (Number of students participated only in Debate + Number of students participated in both Debate and Quiz)

 
• Number of students participated only in Quiz = 68 - (34 + 8)
 
• Number of students participated only in Quiz = 68 - 42 = 26

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b9af2f40b72f9a8696d37b6aabcc36333da7efb786d08c5f28a54470a7ab6b1.png] 

Number of students participated in quiz = Number of students participated only in Quiz + Number of students participated in both Quiz and Debate

**∴ Number of students participated in quiz = 26 + 8 = 34**

Hence, the correct answer is **"34".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8d96688450b10b82fa9953a0a9dbb68b19a4278abdc747812c76821968f69be.png] **
